## Types

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### LineageAnchor

The anchor of an `ImportLineage` (doc 14 §2.3).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: QET 0.200+ project UUID.

   Shape: object { `qet_project_uuid`: [`Uuid`](#uuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `qet_project_uuid` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2). |

2. **Form 2**: SHA-256 of the lineage's first imported file.

   Shape: object { `first_import_sha256`: [`Sha256`](#sha256) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `first_import_sha256` | [`Sha256`](#sha256) | yes |  | A SHA-256 digest sha256:&lt;64 lower-case hex> (doc 05 §3.2). |

3. **Form 3**: "Import as copy" number `n` of another lineage: `{"copy": {"of": <namespace>, "n": n}}`.

   Shape: object { `copy`: [`LineageCopy`](#lineagecopy) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `copy` | [`LineageCopy`](#lineagecopy) | yes |  | The payload of `LineageAnchor::Copy`. |

4. **Form 4**: A fixed label, such as `"golden"` for the golden CSV bootstrap.

   Shape: object { `fixed`: [`Ident`](#ident) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `fixed` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text. |

### LineageCopy

The payload of `LineageAnchor::Copy`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `n` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The copy number. |
| `of` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The **namespace** of the original lineage (`ImportLineage.namespace`), as in `ew_ids::v5::LineageAnchor::Copy` and ADR-0004 amendment 4, not its record ID. |

### Sha256

A SHA-256 digest sha256:&lt;64 lower-case hex> (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

Pattern: `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
